}\n228\t\n229\t    /// Prune trace data (keep metadata only).\n230\t    ///\n231\t    /// Deletes trace.jsonl, stdout.txt, and stderr.txt, keeping only metadata.json.\n232\t    /// Updates the `pruned` flag in metadata.\n233\t    pub fn prune_trace_data(&self) -> Result<()> {\n234\t        if !self.enabled {\n235\t            return Ok(());\n236\t        }\n237\t\n238\t        // Delete // Update metadata to mark as pruned.\n248\t        let metadata_path = self.trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n249\t        if metadata_path.exists() {\n250\t            let content = }\n260\t}\n261\t\n262\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n263\t// Trace format detection\n264\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n265\t\n266\t/// Detect trace format from agent adapter name.\n267\tpub fn detect_trace_format(agent_name: &str) -> TraceFormat {\n268\t    match agent_name {\n269\t        n if n.starts_with(\"claude-\") => TraceFormat::ClaudeJson,\n270\t        n if n.contains(\"codex\") || n.contains(\"openai\") => TraceFormat::OpenaiJsonl,\n271\t        n if n.contains(\"aider\") => TraceFormat::AiderMarkdown,\n272\t        _ => TraceFormat::RawText,\n273\t    }\n274\t}\n275\t\n276\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n277\t// Trace retention cleanup\n278\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n279\t\n280\t/// Cleanup result for trace retention.\n281\t#[derive(Debug, Default)]\n282\tpub struct TraceCleanupSummary {\n283\t    /// Number of traces pruned (metadata kept).\n284\t    pub traces_pruned: u32,\n285\t    /// Number of traces fully deleted.\n286\t    pub traces_deleted: u32,\n287\t}\n288\t\n289\t/// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.\n290\t///\n291\t/// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n292\t/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\n293\tpub fn cleanup_traces(\n294\t    traces_dir: &Path,\n295\t    retention_days_failed: u32,\n296\t    retention_days_success: u32,\n297\t) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n298\t    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n299\t\n300\t    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n301\t        return Ok(summary);\n302\t    }\n303\t\n304\t    let now = SystemTime::now()\n305\t        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n306\t        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n307\t        .unwrap_or(0);\n308\t\n309\t    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n310\t    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n311\t        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n312\t    {\n313\t        let entry = match entry {\n314\t            Ok(e) => e,\n315\t            Err(_) => continue,\n316\t        };\n317\t\n318\t        let path = entry.path();\n319\t\n320\t        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n321\t        if !path.is_dir() {\n322\t            continue;\n323\t        }\n324\t\n325\t        // Check metadata.json to determine outcome and age.\n326\t        let metadata_path = path.join(\"metadata.json\");\n327\t        let metadata: Option<TraceMetadata> = metadata_path\n328\t            .exists()\n329\t            .then(|| {\n330\t                let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path).ok()?;\n331\t                serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n332\t            })\n333\t            .flatten();\n334\t\n335\t        let age_days = metadata\n336\t            .as_ref()\n337\t            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n338\t            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n339\t            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n340\t\n341\t        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n342\t        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n343\t\n344\t        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n345\t        // This prevents counting a trace as \"pruned\" when the data files were\n346\t        // already removed in a previous run but the metadata update failed\n347\t        // or was interrupted. This check is crucial for preventing infinite\n348\t        // loops where the same trace is counted repeatedly.\n349\t        let has_data_files = [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\"]\n350\t            .iter()\n351\t            .any(|file| path.join(file).exists());\n352\t\n353\t        let should_delete = is_failed && age_days > retention_days_failed as u64;\n354\t        // Only prune if metadata says not pruned AND data files actually exist.\n355\t        // If files are gone but metadata says not pruned, we have a partial\n356\t        // state from an interrupted run - fix the metadata and skip counting.\n357\t        let should_prune =\n358\t            !is_failed && !is_pruned && has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64;\n359\t\n360\t        // Fix up metadata for traces that were partially pruned (files gone\n361\t        // but metadata not updated). This prevents infinite loops.\n362\t        if !is_failed && !is_pruned && !has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64 {\n363\t            if let Err(e) = fix_pruned_metadata(&path) {\n364\t                tracing::debug!(\n365\t                    path = %path.display(),\n366\t                    error = %e,\n367\t                    \"failed to fix pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n368\t                );\n369\t            }\n370\t        }\n371\t\n372\t        if should_delete {\n373\t            // Delete entire trace directory.\n374\t            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path) {\n375\t                tracing::warn!(\n376\t                    path = %path.display(),\n377\t                    error = %e,\n378\t                    \"failed to delete old trace directory\"\n379\t                );\n380\t            } else {\n381\t                summary.traces_deleted += 1;\n382\t            }\n383\t        } else if should_prune {\n384\t            // Prune trace data, keep metadata.\n385\t            if let Err(e) = prune_trace_dir(&path) {\n386\t                tracing::warn!(\n387\t                    path = %path.display(),\n388\t                    error = %e,\n389\t                    \"failed to prune trace data\"\n390\t                );\n391\t            } else {\n392\t                summary.traces_pruned += 1;\n393\t            }\n394\t        }\n395\t    }\n396\t\n397\t    Ok(summary)\n398\t}\n399\t\n400\t/// Fix metadata for a trace that was partially pruned (data files gone but\n401\t/// metadata not updated). This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\n402\tfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n403\t    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n404\t    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n405\t        return Ok(());\n406\t    }\n407\t\n408\t    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n409\t    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n410\t        if !metadata.pruned {\n411\t            metadata.pruned = true;\n412\t            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n413\t            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n414\t            tracing::debug!(\n415\t                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n416\t                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n417\t            );\n418\t        }\n419\t    }\n420\t    Ok(())\n421\t}\n422\t\n423\t/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n424\t///\n425\t/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n426\t/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n427\t/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n428\t/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. This prevents\n429\t/// infinite loops where the same traces are counted as \"pruned\" repeatedly.\n430\tfn prune_trace_dir(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n431\t    // Step 1: Update metadata to mark as pruned BEFORE removing files.\n432\t    // This prevents the same trace from being counted as pruned multiple times\n433\t    // if the process is interrupted between metadata update and file removal.\n434\t    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n435\t    if metadata_path.exists() {\n436\t        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n437\t        if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n438\t            metadata.pruned = true;\n439\t            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n440\t            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n441\t        }\n442\t    }\n443\t\n444\t    // Step 2: Remove trace data files after metadata is updated.\n445\t    // Use ? to propagate errors - if file removal fails, the operator should\n446\t    // know so they can investigate. Files that don't exist are skipped.\n447\t    for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\"] {\n448\t        let path = trace_dir.join(file);\n449\t        if path.exists() {\n450\t            std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n451\t                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n452\t        }\n453\t    }\n454\t\n455\t    Ok(())\n456\t}\n457\t\n458\tuse std::time::SystemTime;\n459\t\n460\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n461\t// Tests\n462\t// When `sanitizer` is `Some`, all trace content is sanitized synchronously\n    /// before writing to disk (no unsanitized window on disk).\n    pub fn new_with_sanitizer(\n        bead_id: &BeadId,\n        beads_root: &Path,\n        sanitizer: Option<Arc<Sanitizer>>,\n    ) -> Option<Self> {\n        let trace_dir = beads_root\n            .join(\".beads\")\n            .join(\"traces\")\n            .join(bead_id.as_ref());\n\n        // Create the trace directory.\n        if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&trace_dir) {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                bead_id = %bead_id,\n                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n                error = %e,\n                \"failed to create trace directory, trace capture disabled\"\n            );\n            return None;\n        }\n\n        Some(TraceCapture {\n            trace_dir,\n            enabled: true,\n            sanitizer,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Get the trace directory path.\n    pub fn trace_dir(&self) /// Deletes trace.jsonl, stdout.txt, and stderr.txt, keeping only metadata.json.\n    /// Updates the `pruned` flag in metadata.\n    pub fn prune_trace_data(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.enabled {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Delete trace data files.\n        for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\"] {\n            let path = ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Trace format detection\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// TraceFormat::ClaudeJson,\n        n if n.contains(\"codex\") || n.contains(\"openai\") => TraceFormat::OpenaiJsonl,\n        n if n.contains(\"aider\") => TraceFormat::AiderMarkdown,\n        _ => TraceFormat::RawText,\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Trace retention cleanup\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Cleanup result for trace retention.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct TraceCleanupSummary {\n    /// Number of traces pruned (metadata kept).\n    pub traces_pruned: u32,\n    /// Number of traces fully deleted.\n    pub traces_deleted: u32,\n}\n\n/// Clean up old traces based on retention policy.\n///\n/// - Failed beads (non-zero exit): delete after 30 days\n/// - Successful beads (exit 0): prune data after 7 days, keep metadata only\npub fn cleanup_traces(\n    traces_dir: &Path,\n    retention_days_failed: u32,\n    retention_days_success: u32,\n) -> Result<TraceCleanupSummary> {\n    let mut summary = TraceCleanupSummary::default();\n\n    if !traces_dir.exists() {\n        return Ok(summary);\n    }\n\n    let now = SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n\n    // Iterate through bead trace directories.\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(traces_dir)\n        .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read traces directory: {}\", traces_dir.display()))?\n    {\n        let entry = match entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let path = entry.path();\n\n        // Only process directories (bead-id subdirectories).\n        if !path.is_dir() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check metadata.json to determine outcome and age.\n        let metadata_path = path.join(\"metadata.json\");\n        let metadata: Option<TraceMetadata> = metadata_path\n            .exists()\n            .then(|| {\n                let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path).ok()?;\n                serde_json::from_str(&content).ok()\n            })\n            .flatten();\n\n        let age_days = metadata\n            .as_ref()\n            .and_then(|m| now.checked_sub(m.captured_at.timestamp() as u64))\n            .map(|secs| secs / 86400)\n            .unwrap_or(u64::MAX);\n\n        let is_failed = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.exit_code != 0).unwrap_or(false);\n        let is_pruned = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.pruned).unwrap_or(false);\n\n        // Check if trace data files actually exist before attempting to prune.\n        // This prevents counting a trace as \"pruned\" when the data files were\n        // already removed in a previous run but the metadata update failed\n        // or was interrupted. This check is crucial for preventing infinite\n        // loops where the same trace is counted repeatedly.\n        let has_data_files = [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\"]\n            .iter()\n            .any(|file| path.join(file).exists());\n\n        let should_delete = is_failed && age_days > retention_days_failed as u64;\n        // Only prune if metadata says not pruned AND data files actually exist.\n        // If files are gone but metadata says not pruned, we have a partial\n        // state from an interrupted run - fix the metadata and skip counting.\n        let should_prune =\n            !is_failed && !is_pruned && has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64;\n\n        // Fix up metadata for traces that were partially pruned (files gone\n        // but metadata not updated). This prevents infinite loops.\n        if !is_failed && !is_pruned && !has_data_files && age_days > retention_days_success as u64 {\n            if let Err(e) = fix_pruned_metadata(&path) {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to fix pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        if should_delete {\n            // Delete entire trace directory.\n            if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to delete old trace directory\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_deleted += 1;\n            }\n        } else if should_prune {\n            // Prune trace data, keep metadata.\n            if let Err(e) = prune_trace_dir(&path) {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"failed to prune trace data\"\n                );\n            } else {\n                summary.traces_pruned += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(summary)\n}\n\n/// Fix metadata for a trace that was partially pruned (data files gone but\n/// metadata not updated). This is a recovery operation for interrupted pruning.\nfn fix_pruned_metadata(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n    if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n        if !metadata.pruned {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %trace_dir.display(),\n                \"fixed pruned metadata for partially-pruned trace\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Prune trace data files in a directory, keeping only metadata.json.\n///\n/// Updates metadata FIRST to mark as pruned, then removes data files.\n/// This order is critical: if the process is interrupted after metadata\n/// update but before file removal, the next cleanup will skip this trace\n/// (because is_pruned=true) and only remove remaining files. This prevents\n/// infinite loops where the same traces are counted as \"pruned\" repeatedly.\nfn prune_trace_dir(trace_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    // Step 1: Update metadata to mark as pruned BEFORE removing files.\n    // This prevents the same trace from being counted as pruned multiple times\n    // if the process is interrupted between metadata update and file removal.\n    let metadata_path = trace_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if metadata_path.exists() {\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&metadata_path)?;\n        if let Ok(mut metadata) = serde_json::from_str::<TraceMetadata>(&content) {\n            metadata.pruned = true;\n            let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&metadata)?;\n            std::fs::write(&metadata_path, json)?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Step 2: Remove trace data files after metadata is updated.\n    // Use ? to propagate errors - if file removal fails, the operator should\n    // know so they can investigate. Files that don't exist are skipped.\n    for file in [\"trace.jsonl\", \"stdout.txt\", \"stderr.txt\"] {\n        let path = trace_dir.join(file);\n        if path.exists() {\n            std::fs::remove_file(&path)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to prune trace file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nuse std::time::SystemTime;\n\n//
